verdict.rationale: Perplexity documents an official MCP server that agents can connect to. It is offered as a hosted remote endpoint at https://api.perplexity.ai/mcp and as an open-source local stdio server, with tool-restriction controls. A separate Computer MCP server is also documented. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agents connecting through the MCP server.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can connect an agent via an official MCP server

citations.quote: The Perplexity MCP Server enables AI assistants to access Perplexity's powerful search and reasoning capabilities directly within their workflows.
Remote MCP server (recommended): hosted by Perplexity at `https://api.perplexity.ai/mcp`. No installation, nothing to update, works with any client that supports remote MCP servers.
Local MCP server: run the open-source server on your machine over stdio.
your MCP client can delegate complex, multi-step work to Computer and receive structured results.
